snippet.title: Official Trailer 2: Hunt Together in a Free Browser MMORPG | Pixlaria
snippet.description:
Pixlaria is a free MMORPG you play in your browser, on PC or phone. Nothing to download.

NEW: adventure parties and player guilds. Form a party of up to five adventurers and take on the Stormroot Colossus together, or found a guild with your friends: choose a name, a crest and a tag that shows under every member's name.

Ride a young dragon to anywhere you have been. Explore the Pearl Isles, the Outer Jungle and the frozen north. Master 14 skills, from fishing and woodcutting to gardening. Build and furnish your own home, with cherry blossoms and a koi pond in the garden. Ride horses and unicorns, and face dragons and legendary bosses.

Who would you bring to your party?

Play free: https://www.pixlaria.com/play?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=trailer2
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/wUCMtDXwER

All footage is captured in the game, on a copy of the live world with test characters and cinematic cameras. Garden growth is sped up where marked TIME-LAPSE.

#Pixlaria #MMORPG #BrowserGame
